hero.title: Find your home in the heart of Tashkent
hero.lead: Two apartments in Tashkent city center, seven excursions to Amirsoy, Chimgan and the sights of the city, and airport transfers that run at every hour a plane lands. Local hosts, one WhatsApp thread, no agency in between.
hero.photo: A cream and deep-red apartment building in central Tashkent seen from below against an evening sky.

contacts.title: Talk to a person, not a booking engine
contacts.lead: There is no form on this site and no calendar to fight with. Message us on whichever app you already use and we answer with real availability, the exact address and the meeting details.
contacts.whatsapp-note: Fastest. We usually reply within 10 minutes.
contacts.telegram-note: Same team, same answers, if you prefer Telegram.
